settling_rule: Max over active bonds of end-window strain range, divided by peak active tensile strain (floor 1e-12); also check scalar mean/max ranges; maximum <=0.05. Kinetic energy is reported, not hidden.
failed_settling_policy: Retain end-window strain as explicitly unverified quasi-steady candidate; continue diagnostic run and report MECHANICAL_STEADY_STATE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; never extend window or retune.
study_rule: Compare common slow exposure at/after 0.02 s versus 0.005 s; max-relative denominator max(abs(reference),1e-12) for strain/damage; descriptive tolerance 5%; any failed settling => INCONCLUSIVE.
